evidence.title: Routing & Switching für Ihr Firmennetzwerk - Kellner Telecom GmbH
evidence.excerpt: Eine wichtige Rolle spielt in diesem Zusammenhang das Routing und Switching: Während das Switching als „Ordnungsdienst“ für die lokale Regelung des Netzwerks zuständig ist, stellt das Routing den Knotenpunkt zwischen dem LAN und der Außenwelt dar. Eine wichtige Rolle spielt in diesem Zusammenhang das Routing und Switching: Während das Switching als „Ordnungsdienst“ für die lokale Regelung des Netzwerks zuständig ist, stellt das Routing den Knotenpunkt zwischen dem LAN und der Außenwelt dar. Eine wichtige Rolle spielt in diesem Zusammenhang das Routing und Switching: Während das Switching als „Ordnungsdienst“ für die lokale Regelung des Netzwerks zuständig ist, stellt das Routing den Knotenpunkt zwischen dem LAN und der Außenwelt dar. Wir sind der erste Ansprechpartner rund um das Routing und Switching. * Professioneller Aufbau und Inbetriebnahme von Routing- und Switching-Systemen für Ihr Unternehmensnetzwerk * Umfassende Erfahrung in der Planung und Realisierung komplexer Routing- und Switching-Systeme bei Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen Ihre Fragen zu unserem Angebot rund um Routing und Switching Bei uns erhalten Sie alle Leistungen aus einer Hand: Wir unterstützen Sie von der ersten Machbarkeitsanalyse über die Planung, Projektierung, Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation bis zum Betrieb der Switching- und Routing-Systeme. ## Routing und Switching – die Basis jedes Unternehmensnetzwerks **Router und Switches ermöglichen diesen Datentransport** und stellen damit die Basis für das Internet und alle anderen Netzwerke dar. Switches sind dabei für die interne Kommunikation zuständig: Sie verbinden Computer mit Druckern, Servern und anderen Teilnehmern und schaffen dadurch ein Netzwerk gemeinsam genutzter Ressourcen. **Ein Switch arbeitet im lokalen Netzwerk, während der Router das Tor zur Außenwelt darstellt** und alle ein- und ausgehenden Datenströme anhand von IP-Adressen prüft und weiterleitet. Beide Geräte sind für die korrekte Zustellung von Datenpaketen zuständig, wobei der Router im Netzwerk mächtiger als der Switch ist und dessen Aufgaben auch mitübernehmen kann. Die zentrale Aufgabe des Routers ist die **Steuerung und Prüfung von Datenströmen** – alle aus einem Netzwerk ausgehenden oder in ein Netzwerk eingehenden Daten unterliegen der Prüfung und Erlaubnis des Routers. Aufgabe des Switches ist es, die in einer Zuordnungstabelle gespeicherten Ports und MAC-Adressen zu verwalten und dem Zielgerät der Frames das richtige Zielgerät zuzuweisen. Vereinfacht ausgedrückt ist der Switch für die korrekte Datenvermittlung zwischen Endgerät und Endgerät in einem LAN zuständig.

Netzwerk und WLAN für Unternehmen – sicher, stabil, skalierbar Leistungsschwerpunkt # Netzwerk und WLAN für Unternehmen – sicher, stabil, skalierbar Langsames WLAN in Besprechungsräumen, Drucker nicht erreichbar, kein Homeoffice-Zugriff – typische Probleme eines gewachsenen Firmennetzwerks. Wir planen und bauen Ihr Netzwerk so, dass es zuverlässig, sicher und zukunftsfähig ist. ## Ihr Mehrwert * Stabile und schnelle WLAN-Abdeckung im gesamten Gebäude * Sicherer Fernzugriff für Homeoffice und Außendienst (VPN) * Klare Netzwerkzonen für Gäste, Mitarbeiter und Produktionssysteme * Skalierbar: das Netzwerk wächst mit Ihrem Unternehmen * Weniger Ausfälle durch professionelle Planung und Dokumentation ## Leistungsumfang * Netzwerkplanung und Strukturierung (LAN, WLAN, VPN) * Installation und Konfiguration von Switches, Routern und Access Points * WLAN-Ausleuchtung und Abdeckungsplanung für Gebäude und Hallen * VPN-Einrichtung für sicheres Homeoffice und Außendienstzugriff * Firewall-Konzepte und Netzwerksegmentierung * Netzwerkdokumentation und laufende Betreuung ## So arbeiten wir 1 Bestandsaufnahme und Analyse des vorhandenen Netzwerks 2 Planung der Zielarchitektur mit Anforderungen und Budget 3 Installation, Konfiguration und Abnahmetest 4 Dokumentation, Einweisung und optionaler laufender Support ## Praxisbeispiele ### WLAN-Ausleuchtung für Produktionshalle und Bürogebäude Ausgangslage:Unzureichende WLAN-Abdeckung in der Produktionshalle, Verbindungsabbrüche bei mobilen Geräten. Umsetzung:Professionelle WLAN-Planung mit Access-Point-Platzierung, Controller-basiertem Netz und nahtlosem Roaming. Ergebnis:Vollständige, stabile WLAN-Abdeckung ohne Verbindungsabbrüche. ### Netzwerk-Neustrukturierung nach Unternehmensumzug Ausgangslage:Neuer Standort, kein funktionsfähiges Netzwerk, Büro und Server mussten innerhalb einer Woche produktiv sein. Umsetzung:Vollständiger Netzwerkaufbau inkl. Verkabelung, WLAN und VPN in unter einer Woche. Ergebnis:Pünktlicher Start am neuen Standort ohne Betriebsunterbrechung. ## Häufige Fragen ### Was kostet ein Firmennetzwerk aufbauen? Die Kosten hängen von Gebäudegröße, Anzahl der Nutzer und gewünschten Funktionen ab. Wir erstellen nach einem Vor-Ort-Termin ein transparentes Angebot. ### Kann Solisation auch bestehende Netzwerke verbessern? Ja. Wir analysieren Ihr vorhandenes Netzwerk, identifizieren Schwachstellen und optimieren ohne unnötigen Austausch funktionstüchtiger Komponenten. ### Wie richte ich sicheres WLAN für Gäste ein? Mit einem separaten Gäste-WLAN-Netz, das vom internen Firmennetz getrennt ist. So haben Besucher Internetzugang, ohne Zugriff auf interne Systeme zu bekommen. ### Funktioniert VPN auch mit Microsoft 365 und Homeoffice? Ja. Wir richten VPN-Lösungen ein, die nahtlos mit Microsoft 365, Cloud-Diensten und On-Premises-Systemen zusammenarbeiten. ## Projektstart anfragen Wir beraten Sie zur passenden Umsetzung in Ihrem Unternehmen. evidence.title: Understanding the Variety of System Integration Companies
evidence.excerpt: Software Development, Application Integration # Understanding the Variety of System Integration Companies: SI, VAR, OEM, ISV and MSP Published: Jul 22, 2020 When a company faces the need to transform digitally and tries to find ways to implement and partners to help with [system integration](/applications-integration-services/), it steps to the uncharted territory full of confusing terms. The difference between company types is sometimes so subtle and the partnership model is so complicated even for technical experts. Understanding what a system integrator, value-added reseller, independent software vendor, managed service provider and original equipment manufacturer is may clear the fog of uncertainty and help to choose the system integration partner matching your business needs. --- ## The structure of technology partnership As a business stakeholder, you know that a company can’t take all the markets and sell to one hundred percent of customers. There are various demands, tastes and environments, and one offering is not capable of satisfying them all, especially when dealing with technology. When a company wants to [change business processes](/business-and-system-analysis/) through digital solutions, it may call for custom functionality to match industry-specific, business-specific or company-specific requirements. Customer expectations drive the development of the infrastructure of resellers, distributors and partners capable of tailoring custom solutions. ### What is a system integrator System integrators (SI) are companies competent in combining different third-party software and hardware components into [enterprise-grade systems](/enterprise-software-development/) and possessing capacities to build complex business solutions. Solutions that may comprise multiple technologies, providing consulting, business and system analysis and maintenance and support services according to customer requirements and business needs. System integrators usually serve large-sized companies, industry leaders and enterprises and are not limited by the exclusive partnership agreement from selected vendors or manufacturers. An integrated system consisting of several ready-made software products provided by multiple vendors, custom-developed software, legacy modules and the latest hardware functioning smoothly together to solve business tasks is what a system integrator does. ![System integrator flow diagram]() ### What is a value-added reseller Value-added resellers are resellers of third-party hardware and software of a particular vendor or manufacturer that enhance the products they sell with additional services, software or functionality and make these combinations their key business offerings. VARs work in the field that is overlapping in terms of some operational activities with system integrators as they may offer customers some customization or additional functionality. However, the major difference is that such resellers usually focus on a single third-party vendor or on adding business value to just some selected hardware. Also, value-added resellers may be limited by the vertical they operate in or by vendor’s partnership agreements. And they usually concentrate on providing solutions based on specific products rather than on integrating ad-hoc products and solutions compared to system integrators. Customers of VARs are often small and middle-size businesses. ![Value-added reseller]() ### What is a managed service provider Managed service providers’ key offering is a technology service provided for a recurring fee. Their customers pay for ongoing propositions, including implementation, repair, help-desk support, and everyday administration, etc. MSPs function as IT departments but outsourced ones. Managed service providers usually target small businesses. ![Managed service provider]() ### What is an independent software vendor An independent software vendor is a company that owns a solution that is beneficial to use together with sof

evidence.title: Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors
evidence.excerpt: # Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors #### Ingram, ALSO and Tech Data dominate but there's no shortage of local heroes in the German distribution market, according to our sister title Channelnomics Did you know that seven cents in every euro spent on ICT in Germany travels through just three giant IT distributors? That's one of the more surprising findings of research into the top 30 ICT distributors in Germany which has been carried out by our sister publication, _Channelnomics.eu_. [You can read Part One of the report in full here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/feature/2408497/the-top-30-german-it-distributors-you-need-to-know-part-one "You can read Part One of the report in full here"). Undoubtedly one of the German channel's most striking quirks is the extent to which it is bossed by a trio of distribution goliaths in the form of Ingram Micro, Tech Data and ALSO, who boast combined estimated sales of nearly €11bn. Amanuel Dag, DACH country manager at analyst Context, said the power wielded by this triumvirate is closely linked to the market's highly price-sensitive nature. "The market is more consolidated here in Germany and therefore it's more price competitive than other countries," said Dag. "There's not much profit to make. The margins are always lower than one per cent for box-moving business around PCs, tablet and laptops; it's not a big secret that telecoms distributors are making more on laptop bags than the mobile PCs themselves. The saying ‘get big, get niche or get out' counts a lot for distribution in Germany - either they are big enough to survive or they find a niche with a higher margin." But it is perhaps precisely because Swiss ALSO and US broadline duo Tech Data and Ingram dominate so heavily that there exists below them a formidable pack of quirky home-grown heroes that have carved out a niche outside of box-shifting. _Channelnomics.eu_ began its [Focus in Germany season](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/special/2405808/focus-on-germany "Focus in Germany season") by counting down the country's top 50 resellers - or 'system houses'. Now it's the turn of the distributors, as _Channelnomics_ examines the country's top 30 IT wholesalers by revenue. Part One counts down numbers 20 to 21. Stay tuned for Parts Two and Three, which will review 20 to 11, and 10 to one, respectively. So here we go... **30) Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH - €47m** UK-based Wick Hill is one of Germany's leading security VADs, with local revenues in its fiscal 2014 of €46.7m, up 34 per cent on the previous year. Headquartered in Hamburg (_pictured_) and with 56 staff, [Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH](https://www.wickhill.de/ "Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH") counts WatchGuard, Kaspersky and Fortinet among its key vendors. **29) DELO Computer GmbH - €56m** Peripherals specialist [DELO](http://www.delo.com/ "DELO") saw sales dip by four per cent in 2013 to €56.4m, according to its most recent accounts. evidence.title: Company History
evidence.excerpt: ## Company HistoryInnovation From The Very Beginning. Transfer of our company shares on January 31 to GZS Digital GmbH, a wholly owned subsidiary of Gustav Zech Stiftung. Acquisition of the majority interest in the IT security specialist KORAMIS. Foundation of the subsidiary Netzikon GmbH. euromicron AG acquires the telent GmbH. telent reinforces its service business. through the takeover of the ADC Services GmbH. In the course of a BPO (Business Process Outsourcing). project, telent takes over the COLT field service sector. telent arises from the remaining service. ## Portrait. **The telent GmbH is a service provider and telecommunications company based in Backnang. It offers more than 50 years of experience in the area of technology, project planning, installation, commissioning as well as operation and maintenance of communication networks. The company has arisen from Telefunken founded in 1903 and has been based in Backnang since 1954 (AEG Telefunken, ANT Nachrichtentechnik, Bosch Telecom, Marconi).**. Today, telent GmbH offers tailor-made technology solutions and services for the area of mission critical infrastructures, digitalization and industrial plants. For operational and safety-related communication, telent plans, builds up and operates for its customers the necessary network infrastructures composed of most state-of-the-art products and systems from various renowned and well-known manufacturers. These systems guarantee maximum availability and security for all IT equipment and thus for the associated business-critical processes in companies and organizations. When networking and automating digital business processes, telent GmbH focuses on comprehensive experience and competence in the fields of cybersecurity, state-of-the-art IP and operational networks, PMR, IoT, wireless-access (pLTE / 5G) as well as technology and infrastructure service for e-mobility, as an example. The company contributes its know-how to the setup of appropriate IT/OT infrastructures required to implement Smart Energy and Smart Transportation applications more quickly, as well as solutions for both industrial and public sectors in Germany.

evidence.title: telent and Deutsche GigaNetz put 200th PoP site into operation
evidence.excerpt: 4. telent and Deutsche GigaNetz put 200th PoP site into operation. # telent and Deutsche GigaNetz put 200th PoP site into operation. **Backnang, 29.01.2025 - telent GmbH has been working for Deutsche GigaNetz GmbH as a turnkey partner and general contractor for the nationwide fibre optic expansion since 2020 as part of a framework contract. Deutsche GigaNetz is one of the leading telecommunications companies for the roll-out and expansion of fibre optic networks in Germany.**. As part of the broadband expansion projects, telent has developed the entire generic network concept for the PoP sites (Point of Presence) together with Deutsche GigaNetz. As general contractor, telent supplies turnkey PoP sites for these expansion projects with the complete site equipment, including active system technology (Nokia 7360 FX iSAM), and maintains and eliminate these as part of the existing maintenance and service contract. Two different types are used for the PoP locations: A-PoP (Access PoP) as a telecommunications container in various sizes and O-PoP (Outdoor PoP) as a multifunctional housing MFG18. In recent years, telent experts have already set up and equipped around 300 PoP locations for the important nationwide network expansion with future-proof fibre optic technology. In December 2024, the important milestone of connecting the 200th PoP location to Deutsche GigaNetz's fibre optic network was reached in close cooperation. This means that Deutsche GigaNetz customers can reliably use a state-of-the-art, stable fibre optic network with high-speed Internet and high bandwidths. Private customers have been using the energy-efficient GPON technology as part of the MyNet product family right from the start. This provides data rates of between 150 Mbit/s and 2.5 Gbit/s (download). With the ProNet product family, business customers also benefit from high-bit-rate XGS-PON connections with up to 10 Gbit/s (symmetrical). Peter Mertens, telent's general project manager, emphasises the excellent cooperation with the Deutsche GigaNetz project teams involved: "This outstanding performance was only possible thanks to the consistently high level of commitment on both sides in all phases of the project.". telent Key Account Manager Alexander Scharf adds: "telent is pleased to continue the existing successful partnership with Deutsche GigaNetz and, as usual, to be a reliable, competent partner and prime contractor for future expansion projects.".

evidence.title: Network Operators
evidence.excerpt: ## System technology and services fornetwork operators. Network operators are facing constant change. Rapid technological progress (broadband, cloud, IoT, 5G) and the ongoing trend toward networking and digitization of social processes are playing a decisive role in this. In addition to large telecommunications companies and regional and national operators, municipalities, cities, and counties are being called upon to build new infrastructure and provide services. Depending on the required bandwidth, different wired or wireless transmission technologies are used to meet communication requirements. The applications are diverse and range from traditional broadband services to the networking of systems and facilities for future electromobility, smart cities, and intelligent transport systems. As a system integrator, telent combines technologies and systems from different manufacturers to optimally meet individual requirements. ## Quality of living and business spaceBroadband connectivity as a locational advantage. In addition to basic utilities such as water, energy, telecommunications, and public transportation, broadband connectivity is becoming increasingly important for residential areas. Today, good broadband connectivity is a key location advantage that is crucial for retaining and expanding regional and national companies. Especially when setting up branches that need to network with the company headquarters or their customers, an existing broadband connection is an essential criterion for choosing a location. At a time when fast broadband connectivity is becoming a decisive competitive factor, telent offers you customized fiber optic solutions instead of standard solutions. We offer you a strategic partnership and future-proof solutions that not only strengthen the economy, but also sustainably increase the quality of life and attractiveness of your region. High availability, reliability, and cybersecurity are crucial aspects for next-generation communication networks. Continuous network monitoring helps to detect and locate errors and attacks. As a partner company, telent offers such 24-hour support every day of the year. With our Service Competence Center (SCC) and a Managed Network Operations Center (M-NOC), we are available to customers 24/7 for all services in the field of active technology. As a provider-independent network operator for open access networks, we have set up service locations and spare parts warehouses throughout Germany in order to be able to provide comprehensive support to our customers.

Juni 2011 # euromicron takes over business operations of telent GmbH Deutschland and initiates the second stage in its corporate strategy as planned euromicron acquired the business operations of telent GmbH Deutschland from Pension Corporation (UK) under an asset deal on June 7, 2011. telent GmbH is a vendor-independent system integrator and technology service provider for communications networks and has a nationwide service team. In the field of system integration, telent GmbH specializes in the technology segments of transmission technology, IP migration, infrastructure, integrated control station technology and professional mobile communications/trunking. It also offers services such as assembly, commissioning and maintenance of technical systems and communications networks. telent GmbH is headquartered in Backnang. Its origins date back to the company Telefunken in 1907 and its current history began in 1954, since when it has been part of AEG Telefunken, Bosch Telecom and Marconi, before being taken over by euromicron. Employing a workforce of around 400, telent GmbH builds and monitors infrastructure for prestigious European carriers, power utilities, large private enterprises and public authorities from the sectors of transport and security. With its extensive technology know-how and a “24-hour Service Competence Center”, the company supports its customers as a partner for complete system solutions at three branch offices and eleven service locations in Germany. The company, which is established in Germany, cooperates with selected partners such as Ericsson, Keymile, Cisco, Motorola, Ceragon and Nexans to offer customers tailored solutions. The existing Managing Directors of telent GmbH, Dr. Stefan Kindt, Robert Blum and Hans-Peter Fischer, will continue to run the company. “With our many years of experience, great technical know-how and motivated employees, we look forward to making a major contribution to the further development of the euromicron Group. Thanks to the new lineup, we can offer our customers an even broader range of services,” stated Dr. Stefan Kindt. The profitable company generates sales in the upper single-digit million range. telent GmbH Deutschland will contribute sales of around €90 million and an EBIT of €6 million to euromicron’s consolidated results as of 2012. euromicron sees interesting potentials and synergies as a result of integration of telent GmbH in the group: * A complementary portfolio of customers, products, service and know-how, etc. * High potential in planning, implementing and maintaining complex networks with various applications * Great technological and problem-solving expertise * Experienced, highly qualified employees * Expansion of the customer base “Takeover of the business operations of telent GmbH Deutschland is of great importance for expanding both parties’ business and will initiate the next stage in euromicron AG’s corporate strategy, which will take the group closer to achieving the 300 million sales mark in 2011,” says Dr. Späth, Chairman of the Executive Board. telent GmbH ([www.telent.de](http://www.telent.de)) is an independent vendor of solutions relating to networks and systems for enterprise and security-related communication. evidence.excerpt: # Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors #### Ingram, ALSO and Tech Data dominate but there's no shortage of local heroes in the German distribution market, according to our sister title Channelnomics Did you know that seven cents in every euro spent on ICT in Germany travels through just three giant IT distributors? That's one of the more surprising findings of research into the top 30 ICT distributors in Germany which has been carried out by our sister publication, _Channelnomics.eu_. [You can read Part One of the report in full here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/feature/2408497/the-top-30-german-it-distributors-you-need-to-know-part-one "You can read Part One of the report in full here"). Undoubtedly one of the German channel's most striking quirks is the extent to which it is bossed by a trio of distribution goliaths in the form of Ingram Micro, Tech Data and ALSO, who boast combined estimated sales of nearly €11bn. Amanuel Dag, DACH country manager at analyst Context, said the power wielded by this triumvirate is closely linked to the market's highly price-sensitive nature. "The market is more consolidated here in Germany and therefore it's more price competitive than other countries," said Dag. "There's not much profit to make. The margins are always lower than one per cent for box-moving business around PCs, tablet and laptops; it's not a big secret that telecoms distributors are making more on laptop bags than the mobile PCs themselves. The saying ‘get big, get niche or get out' counts a lot for distribution in Germany - either they are big enough to survive or they find a niche with a higher margin." But it is perhaps precisely because Swiss ALSO and US broadline duo Tech Data and Ingram dominate so heavily that there exists below them a formidable pack of quirky home-grown heroes that have carved out a niche outside of box-shifting. _Channelnomics.eu_ began its [Focus in Germany season](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/special/2405808/focus-on-germany "Focus in Germany season") by counting down the country's top 50 resellers - or 'system houses'. evidence.excerpt: Title: Dell Networking for smart networking environments | sva.de # Dell Networking for smart networking environments. ## What Is Dell Networking? Dell Networking offers everything that service providers, software providers and public authorities need to send and receive data in a networked environment. ### Hardware: Which Dell network devices are used? Dell’s range of network devices meets the current IEEE standards and is among the most comprehensive of its class. Dell not only offers operating system software for managing switches and functions in various environments like edge, cloud or core, but also complex layer 2 and 3 management software for administering virtual or physical networks such as Open Networking and SmartFabric Director. Dell also responds to the demand for open networking, greater transmission volumes, AI and special security systems. ## What are the benefits of Dell Networking? What are the benefits of Dell Networking? The integrated hardware and software solutions for edge environments make it possible to implement virtualized SD-WAN architectures immediately (SD-WAN stands for software-defined wide area network). ## Why Dell Networking with SVA? As a Dell Titanium Partner, SVA has direct access to the entire networking portfolio. ## FAQs: Frequently asked questions about Dell Networking. #### Why use networking solutions from Dell Networking? Years of experience, excellent value for money and a huge range of premium network solutions for data centers, core networks, campuses and edge networks are just some of the reasons why customers around the world use Dell products for their projects. In terms of software, Dell has created various open network solutions with VMware and network partners. #### How does Dell Networking OS10 differ from Dell OS9? The Dell EMC OS9 operating system was developed for high performance in the world’s largest and most demanding IT environments. The new operating system, OS10, is based on Debian Linux and can be implemented on all Open Network Install Environment (ONIE) switches. As it runs in a Linux environment, network administrators can automate the network platform to a high degree and manage the switches in a similar way to Linux servers. #### How interoperable are Dell Networking and spanning tree? The Dell Networking product portfolio is interoperable with STP.

evidence.title: Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors
evidence.excerpt: # Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors #### Ingram, ALSO and Tech Data dominate but there's no shortage of local heroes in the German distribution market, according to our sister title Channelnomics Did you know that seven cents in every euro spent on ICT in Germany travels through just three giant IT distributors? That's one of the more surprising findings of research into the top 30 ICT distributors in Germany which has been carried out by our sister publication, _Channelnomics.eu_. [You can read Part One of the report in full here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/feature/2408497/the-top-30-german-it-distributors-you-need-to-know-part-one "You can read Part One of the report in full here"). Undoubtedly one of the German channel's most striking quirks is the extent to which it is bossed by a trio of distribution goliaths in the form of Ingram Micro, Tech Data and ALSO, who boast combined estimated sales of nearly €11bn. Amanuel Dag, DACH country manager at analyst Context, said the power wielded by this triumvirate is closely linked to the market's highly price-sensitive nature. "The market is more consolidated here in Germany and therefore it's more price competitive than other countries," said Dag. "There's not much profit to make. The margins are always lower than one per cent for box-moving business around PCs, tablet and laptops; it's not a big secret that telecoms distributors are making more on laptop bags than the mobile PCs themselves. The saying ‘get big, get niche or get out' counts a lot for distribution in Germany - either they are big enough to survive or they find a niche with a higher margin." But it is perhaps precisely because Swiss ALSO and US broadline duo Tech Data and Ingram dominate so heavily that there exists below them a formidable pack of quirky home-grown heroes that have carved out a niche outside of box-shifting. _Channelnomics.eu_ began its [Focus in Germany season](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/special/2405808/focus-on-germany "Focus in Germany season") by counting down the country's top 50 resellers - or 'system houses'. You can read Part One [here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/analysis/2405754/the-50-german-vars-you-need-to-know-part-one "here"), Part Two [here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/analysis/2405960/the-50-german-vars-you-need-to-know-part-two "here"), Part Three [here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/analysis/2406293/the-50-german-vars-you-need-to-know-part-three "here"), Part Four [here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/profile/2406402/the-50-german-vars-you-need-to-know-part-four "here") and Part Five [here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/profile/2406609/the-50-german-vars-you-need-to-know-part-five "here"). Now it's the turn of the distributors, as _Channelnomics_ examines the country's top 30 IT wholesalers by revenue. Part One counts down numbers 20 to 21. Stay tuned for Parts Two and Three, which will review 20 to 11, and 10 to one, respectively. So here we go... **30) Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH - €47m** UK-based Wick Hill is one of Germany's leading security VADs, with local revenues in its fiscal 2014 of €46.7m, up 34 per cent on the previous year. Headquartered in Hamburg (_pictured_) and with 56 staff, [Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH](https://www.wickhill.de/ "Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH") counts WatchGuard, Kaspersky and Fortinet among its key vendors. **29) DELO Computer GmbH - €56m** Peripherals specialist [DELO](http://www.delo.com/ "DELO") saw sales dip by four per cent in 2013 to €56.4m, according to its most recent accounts. Founded in 1987, the Recklinghausen-based outfit counts Toshiba, Viewsonic, LG, APC, D-Link and Samsung among its key vendors and claims to serve more than 6,000 dealers and resellers. evidence.title: Enterprise-WLAN & Netzwerk-Gesamtlösung | Beschützerbox
evidence.excerpt: # Enterprise-WLAN & Netzwerk­lösung aus einer Hand Wir liefern nicht nur Router mit rechtssicherem WLAN, sondern bauen für Unternehmen und Einrichtungen das komplette Netzwerk auf – vom Gateway über Switches bis zum Access Point als eine durchdachte Gesamtlösung. Dabei können wir auf die Unterstützung des Hardware-Herstellers TP-Link zurückgreifen. Gemeinsam liefern wir Ihnen ein starkes, skalierbares und bezahlbares Netzwerk. Mit 5 Jahren Garantie auf die Hardwarekomponenten und auf Ihre Bedürfnisse angepasstem Support. Von der Planung und Ausleuchtung des Standorts, über die Wahl von Gateway, Switches und Access Points bis zur zentralen Verwaltung können wir Ihnen je nach Einsatzort, Umfang, Nutzerzahl und sonstigen Ansprüchen an das Netzwerk eine passende Enterprise-WLAN-Lösung zusammenstellen. Auf Wunsch trennen wir Gäste- und internes Netzwerk sauber per VLAN. Dabei sind wir wie gewohnt flexibel, was die Integration von bereits vorhandenen Netzwerkkomponenten angeht. Zentrale Verwaltung der gesamten Netzwerk-Infrastruktur – skalierbar und ausfallsicher. Rechtssicherheit und Datenschutz: DSGVO-konform durch unseren deutschen VPN. Sie haben die Wahl: kontinuerlichen Support durch uns als Partner von TP-Link oder einmaliger Kauf mit Selbstverwaltung. In jedem Fall keine kleinteiligen Abokosten pro Gerät oder für bestimmte Features. Für mehr Flexibilität und Nachhaltigkeit. Stabiles, belastbares WLAN mit hoher Bandbreite – auch in High-Density-Umgebungen. ## Langjährige Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Anwendungsorten ### Hotels Hotel-Netzwerk mit Gäste-WLAN-Login über Ticketcodes oder Voucher. Einfaches Einbinden von hauseigenen Geräten wie Fernsehern. [Mehr zum Gäste-WLAN für Hotels →](/hotels) ### Outletstores & Malls Access Points für High-Density-Umgebungen und Werbung über Splash Pages, inkl. Sammeln von E-Mail-Adressen für Newsletter. ### Soziale Einrichtungen Sichere Netzwerke für Kinder, Jugendliche, Altersbetreuung oder Flüchtlinge. Mit Ticketsystemen für zeitliche Zugangsbeschränkung und Kinder- und Jugendschutz je nach Netzwerk. [Mehr zum WLAN für soziale Einrichtungen →](/soziale-einrichtungen) ### Schulen & Bildungseinrichtungen Schul-WLAN und Schulnetze für Schulen, Fortbildungsstätten oder Büchereien – zentrale, sichere Netzwerke für die öffentliche Digitalisierung (z. B. im Rahmen des DigitalPakts). ### Wohnheime & Studentenwohnheime WLAN-Netzwerk für Wohnheime, Studentenwohnheime, Boardinghouses und Mehrfamilienhäuser – auch bei Vermietung an Expats, Monteure und Saisonarbeiter. Viele Komponenten, ein verbindendes Merkmal: Rechtssichere Netzwerke ## Zertifizierter TP-Link-Partner Wir sind TP-Link-Partner mit Netzwerk- und Wireless-Zertifizierungen für die Omada-Produktreihe. Bei größeren Projekten binden wir den Hersteller direkt in die Planung ein – und über die Partnerschaft gelten fünf Jahre Garantie auf die verbaute Omada-Hardware. ## Fragen Sie ein Angebot an Jedes Netzwerk ist individuell und kann auf unterschiedlichen Wegen aufgebaut und optimiert werden. Daher bieten wir keine "one-size-fits-all"-Lösung an, sondern setzen uns konkret mit Ihren Anforderungen und Ideen auseinander. Am Ende dieses Prozesses soll ein sicheres, stabiles Netzwerk mit der bestmöglichen Surferfahrung für den Endnutzer stehen. Vielen Dank für Ihre Anfrage! Wir werden uns schnellstmöglich bei Ihnen melden. Es ist ein Fehler aufgetreten. Bitte versuchen Sie es später erneut oder kontaktieren Sie uns unter [mail@beschuetzerbox.de](mailto:mail@beschuetzerbox.de).

evidence.title: Wi-Fi site survey / measurement with Ekahau - Germany
evidence.excerpt: [Skip to content](#content) * [![](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==)English](# "Switch to English") + [![](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==)Deutsch](https://codemaschine.de/net/site-survey/ "Switch to Deutsch") [+49 40 39876555](tel:+494039876555) [info@codemaschine.de](mailto:info@codemaschine.de) [![](https://codemaschine.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/cm-logo-schwarz.webp)](https://codemaschine.de/en/) # Wi-Fi Site Survey do it right ## You can only optimize what you can measure. A Wi-Fi site survey is the basis for stable and high-performance Wi-Fi networks in companies. We use professional on-site measurements to identify dead spots, sources of interference, channel overlaps or bottlenecks in data throughput. Thanks to state-of-the-art technology – e.g. Ekahau AI Pro and Sidekick 2 – we analyze the actual Wi-Fi coverage in offices, warehouses or production facilities. We visualize the results in clear heat maps, which serve as a basis for planning and recommendations for optimization. ![Workers during WLAN measurement - Site Survey](https://codemaschine.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/arbeiter_bei_messung_mob.webp "arbeiter_bei_messung_mob") ![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27357%27%20height%3D%271000%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20357%201000%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27357%27%20height%3D%271000%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E) ## Site survey procedure ## Preparation We need the floor plans or building or site plans of the object to be measured in advance. We integrate these into the measurement software. We mainly use the industry-standard EKAHAU AI Pro software. ## Measurement An experienced technician comes to you and systematically measures the Wi-Fi in all relevant areas – using professional equipment (e.g. Ekahau Sidekick 2). Signal strength, channel distribution, interference and other parameters are recorded. ## Report We then prepare all the measurement results in a professional report. You receive heat maps, detailed analyses and clear recommendations for action to optimize your Wi-Fi. ## What we can measure ## Signal Strength (RSSI) Shows how strong the Wi-Fi signal is being received in dBm – just far more precise than any smartphone display. ## Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) The quality of the signal. Indicates how good the signal is compared to the background noise – crucial for stable connections. ## Second Signal Strength (redundancy) For reliability: Should an access point fail, is an alternative signal available? ## Channel Overlaps Wi-Fi is divided into channels in the 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz and 6 GHz bands. Channel overlaps of the same channels lead to a loss of performance. ## Interference Sources The 2.4 GHz band in particular is also used by other devices such as Bluetooth headphones, radios and microwaves. ## Data Throughput With Active Site Survey, we also measure upload and download speeds – how fast can data actually be transferred in the Wi-Fi? ## Site Survey [Get a quote now](https://codemaschine.de/en/contact-us/?service=survey) Our prices depend on the size of the object to be measured – we will be happy to provide you with an individual quote. from €950 for small buildings larger buildings Price on request plus travel and accommodation costs +49 40 / 3 9876 555 [![](https://codemaschine.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/logo.png)](https://codemaschine.de/en/) [+49 40 39876555](tel:+494039876555) © 2012 - 2026 - CODE MASCHINE GmbH - [Imprint](/en/imprint/) [Page load link](#) [Go to Top](#)

evidence.title: LANCOM - Controlware
evidence.excerpt: Title: LANCOM - Controlware ## LANCOM. LANCOM Systems GmbH is a leading European manufacturer of networking technology and IT security solutions, headquartered in Würselen near Aachen. Founded in 2002, the company emerged from a management buyout of the networking division of the former ELSA AG and has been a wholly owned subsidiary of the Munich-based technology group Rohde & Schwarz since 2018. LANCOM offers a comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions for wide area networks (WAN), local area networks (LAN), wireless LAN (WLAN), firewalls, as well as cloud-based software-defined networking (SDN). The development and production of both hardware and software take place predominantly in Germany, as does the hosting of the LANCOM Management Cloud. LANCOM places particular emphasis on security and trustworthiness: its products are free of backdoors and carry the “IT Security Made in Germany” trust label initiated by the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs. In addition, selected components are certified by the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI). #### Partner since :. #### Partner Status :. #### Focus-topics.

Founded in 1949, Flughafen München GmbH (FMG) and its subsidiaries operate Munich Airport. The Bavarian aviation hub is Germany's second largest airport and the only five-star airport in Europe. As a "full-service operator", it offers services in all areas of airport management. Since its opening in 1992, Munich Airport has been one of the busiest airports in Europe, number two in Germany and today an important air traffic hub of international standing. With more than 9,000 employees across the group and a turnover of more than 1.3 billion euros in 2016, the company is one of the largest workplaces in Bavaria. ### The rollout project for a new network at Munich Airport. ### **Requirements**. * Munich Airport wants to expand and renew its entire campus network. * Large parts of the LAN infrastructure must be replaced during ongoing operations in the FMG security area. * Old switches are to be replaced by "state of the art" products from CISCO. ### **Services & Solutions**. * Planning, project management, implementation, documentation and approval. * Delivery of network components in the core area. * Installation and commissioning of the components in the distribution and access area. * Disposal of the old equipment. ### **Advantages & benefits**. * The network infrastructure of Munich Airport was modernised through the use of new Cisco components. * The expansion took place during ongoing operations - without disrupting the approximately 300 customers and about 30,000 end systems. * Munich Airport now has one of the most modern campus networks. #### Solution partner:. Cisco, the world's leading IT provider, helps companies seize tomorrow's business opportunities today. The networking of people, processes, data and things creates unparalleled opportunities. * Link zu Flughafen München GmbH.

June 2026 Effective immediately, we are collaborating closely with IT and managed service provider Controlware to help energy facility and grid operators effectively secure their OT environments against cyberattacks, prevent outages, and comply with regulations such as NIS2 and the German Energy Industry Act (EnWG). We are combining our StationGuard attack detection solution with Controlware’s consulting, integration, and operational services. This collaboration provides energy utilities with comprehensive OT security solutions that address cyber and operational risks. "In OMICRON, we have found a technology partner whose solutions were developed specifically for the OT energy sector. Together, we deliver not just a product, but a comprehensive operational and accountability model for safe switchgear - with 24/7 monitoring, structured escalation procedures, and traceable documentation. This ensures complete transparency in critical grids, reduces response times, and supports compliance with regulatory requirements." - Christopher Gasteier, Business Development Manager OT/ICS, Controlware ## Comprehensive OT Security for the Power Grid Energy companies are facing an increasingly dynamic threat landscape. At the same time, operators of critical infrastructure must comply with ever-stricter legal and regulatory requirements and meet the highest standards for system availability. Against this backdrop, we are partnering with Controlware in a strategic collaboration that combines technological precision with structured operational processes. Our threat detection platform, StationGuard, monitors network communication in digital switchgear in real time. It detects cyber attacks, unauthorized activities, and misconfigurations, and also identifies functional anomalies, such as command errors or anomalies on the station bus. The alerts are then formatted in a way that is understandable to protection and SCADA engineers and can be integrated into existing SIEM and SOC structures. Controlware ensures that these insights do not remain isolated but are translated into reliable decision-making and robust processes: Controlware experts conduct OT risk analyses, develop zoning concepts, integrate the solution into existing architectures, and, upon request, take over 24/7 operations - including monitoring, assessment, escalation, and incident response. This creates a comprehensive security and operations model that combines technical detection, organizational measures, and compliance requirements. The joint offering is rounded out by jointly delivered services ranging from the initial assessment through initial proof-of-value projects to production operations with managed services. These include, among other things, asset and risk analyses, the implementation of intrusion detection systems, the establishment of vulnerability and patch management workflows, and regular compliance reporting. In this way, customers benefit in four key ways: * Early detection of cyberattacks reduces response times and prevents security incidents from escalating * By combining cyber and operational monitoring, the risks of production and supply disruptions can be minimized and costly outages avoided * Regulatory requirements such as the EnWG and NIS2 are reliably implemented through documentable measures, audit support, and monitoring reports * Ou

evidence.excerpt: # Lünendonk List 2021: DATAGROUP is Once Again Among Germany’s Leading IT Service Providers. Among the leading IT service providers in Germany, DATAGROUP ranks fifth among the top 10 IT service providers and rises by one rank compared to 2020.**. For the current lists by Lünendonk and Hossenfelder on the IT market in Germany, around 80 IT service providers and around 140 IT managers were surveyed from February to April 2021 using extensive qualified questionnaires. Customers demand a broad, interdisciplinary spectrum from IT service providers with a wide portfolio breadth to support this development. With the help of the modular CORBOX, the IT service provider supports companies in laying the foundations for digitization - whether on premises, in the private cloud in Germany, in a public cloud or in hybrid scenarios. DATAGROUP forms the engine room of digitization for customers and starts exactly where they need support in a practice-oriented manner and at eye level with the customer. Within the Lünendonk list of leading IT service companies, DATAGROUP again shows the strongest growth among the top 10. The new 2021 Lünendonk lists "Leading IT consulting and system integration companies in Germany" and "Leading IT service companies in Germany" are now available for free download at (in German). For the Lünendonk study "Leading IT consulting and IT service companies in Germany" - with special chapters on medium-sized IT companies and the leading internal IT service providers - around 140 IT managers from upper medium-sized companies as well as from large companies and corporations were surveyed in addition to around 80 IT service providers. DATAGROUP is one of the leading German IT service companies. With its CORBOX product, DATAGROUP is a full service provider and supports over 600,000 IT workstations worldwide for medium-sized and large companies as well as public clients. evidence.title: Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors
evidence.excerpt: # Meet Germany's top 30 IT distributors #### Ingram, ALSO and Tech Data dominate but there's no shortage of local heroes in the German distribution market, according to our sister title Channelnomics Did you know that seven cents in every euro spent on ICT in Germany travels through just three giant IT distributors? That's one of the more surprising findings of research into the top 30 ICT distributors in Germany which has been carried out by our sister publication, _Channelnomics.eu_. [You can read Part One of the report in full here](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/feature/2408497/the-top-30-german-it-distributors-you-need-to-know-part-one "You can read Part One of the report in full here"). Undoubtedly one of the German channel's most striking quirks is the extent to which it is bossed by a trio of distribution goliaths in the form of Ingram Micro, Tech Data and ALSO, who boast combined estimated sales of nearly €11bn. Amanuel Dag, DACH country manager at analyst Context, said the power wielded by this triumvirate is closely linked to the market's highly price-sensitive nature. "The market is more consolidated here in Germany and therefore it's more price competitive than other countries," said Dag. "There's not much profit to make. The margins are always lower than one per cent for box-moving business around PCs, tablet and laptops; it's not a big secret that telecoms distributors are making more on laptop bags than the mobile PCs themselves. The saying ‘get big, get niche or get out' counts a lot for distribution in Germany - either they are big enough to survive or they find a niche with a higher margin." But it is perhaps precisely because Swiss ALSO and US broadline duo Tech Data and Ingram dominate so heavily that there exists below them a formidable pack of quirky home-grown heroes that have carved out a niche outside of box-shifting. _Channelnomics.eu_ began its [Focus in Germany season](http://www.channelnomics.eu/channelnomics-eu/special/2405808/focus-on-germany "Focus in Germany season") by counting down the country's top 50 resellers - or 'system houses'. Now it's the turn of the distributors, as _Channelnomics_ examines the country's top 30 IT wholesalers by revenue. Part One counts down numbers 20 to 21. Stay tuned for Parts Two and Three, which will review 20 to 11, and 10 to one, respectively. So here we go... **30) Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH - €47m** UK-based Wick Hill is one of Germany's leading security VADs, with local revenues in its fiscal 2014 of €46.7m, up 34 per cent on the previous year. Headquartered in Hamburg (_pictured_) and with 56 staff, [Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH](https://www.wickhill.de/ "Wick Hill Kommunikationstechnik GmbH") counts WatchGuard, Kaspersky and Fortinet among its key vendors. **29) DELO Computer GmbH - €56m** Peripherals specialist [DELO](http://www.delo.com/ "DELO") saw sales dip by four per cent in 2013 to €56.4m, according to its most recent accounts. Founded in 1987, the Recklinghausen-based outfit counts Toshiba, Viewsonic, LG, APC, D-Link and Samsung among its key vendors and claims to serve more than 6,000 dealers and resellers. Whether based on a drawing, sketch or sample, we realize your projects with the highest precision and efficiency. We also manufacture customized handling tools for robots and automation systems to optimally support your production processes. Trust in our expertise for high-quality and tailor-made solutions. ## Mechanical processing #### ## assembly of components #### ## prototypes and fixture construction #### ## electrical engineering #### ![]() ![]() ![]() ![]() ![]() ![]() COLLABORATIONS ### We work with you to develop perfect solutions for your challenges! # 01 With our many years of experience and state-of-the-art technology, we meet the highest quality standards in manufacturing and can even meet complex requirements. # 02 Our range of services includes a wide range of processing steps such as milling, turning, drilling, threading, knurling, grinding and much more to offer you tailor-made solutions. # 03 When it comes to surface and heat treatments, we work closely with experienced partners to ensure precise and long-lasting processing. # 04 By using modern software solutions in production planning and control, we guarantee on-time production and smooth processes. ## **Efficient and Powerful** ### Our continuous growth and expansion to now 7 experienced employees are evidence of our stable development. Thanks to our technically competent and motivated team, as well as a modern CNC machine park, we are able to meet even the highest quality requirements. This combination of technical know-how and innovative manufacturing technology contributes significantly to our success and ensures the reliable implementation of your projects. ### **Our package** In contract manufacturing, short distances and reliable execution are important – and that is exactly what we offer you with our comprehensive package. Bima GmbH takes care of all the work for you, from the first step to the finished product. This includes surface finishing, welding work, ordering standard parts, assembly, commissioning and test runs. Everything is done with the utmost care and our comprehensive know-how. Once completed, we deliver the products directly to you personally in our own company vehicle – punctually and reliably. Netzwerktechnologie. Mit theoretischen Geschwindigkeiten von bis zu 46 Gbit/s und Latenzen unter 5 Millisekunden klingt der neue Standard nach einem Quantensprung. Doch lohnt sich der Umstieg für Ihr Unternehmen wirklich schon jetzt? Oder ist es klüger, noch zu warten? In diesem Artikel beleuchten wir die technischen Neuerungen, bewerten den praktischen Nutzen für KMU und geben konkrete Empfehlungen für Ihre Investitionsentscheidung. ## Was ist WiFi 7 technisch? WiFi 7, offiziell als IEEE 802.11be mit dem Zusatz **„Extremely High Throughput”** (EHT) bezeichnet, ist die siebte Generation des WLAN-Standards. Die WiFi Alliance hat im Januar 2024 die offizielle Zertifizierung gestartet, und seit Mitte 2025 sind die ersten Enterprise-Access-Points am Markt verfügbar. Der Standard nutzt wie WiFi 6E die drei Frequenzbänder **2,4 GHz, 5 GHz und 6 GHz**, bringt aber entscheidende technische Verbesserungen: ### 320-MHz-Kanäle: Doppelte Bandbreite WiFi 6 nutzt maximal 160-MHz-Kanäle. WiFi 7 verdoppelt diese Bandbreite auf **320 MHz** – allerdings nur im 6-GHz-Band, wo auch entsprechend Platz dafür ist. Diese Verdopplung der Kanalbreite ist vergleichbar mit dem Ausbau einer zweispurigen Autobahn auf vier Spuren: Es können einfach mehr Daten gleichzeitig übertragen werden. Im 5-GHz-Band bleibt es bei 160 MHz, da dort nicht genug Spektrum für breitere Kanäle verfügbar ist. Das 2,4-GHz-Band unterstützt wie bisher maximal 40 MHz. ### 4096-QAM: 20 Prozent mehr Daten pro Übertragung Die **Quadraturamplitudenmodulation** (QAM) bestimmt, wie viele Bits pro Symbol übertragen werden können. öffnet den Netzwerkschrank und steht vor einem Chaos aus Kabeln, bei dem niemand mehr weiß, welches wohin führt. Genau das soll strukturierte Verkabelung verhindern. In diesem Artikel erklären wir Ihnen, was dahintersteckt und warum dieses Konzept für jedes Unternehmen relevant ist. ## Was bedeutet strukturierte Verkabelung? Strukturierte Verkabelung ist ein standardisiertes System für die gesamte Daten- und Kommunikationsverkabelung in Gebäuden. Statt für jede Anwendung separate Kabel zu verlegen – eines für Telefon, eines für Computer, eines für Drucker – nutzt ein strukturiertes System eine einheitliche Infrastruktur für alle Dienste. Das Prinzip ist simpel: Eine durchdachte, einheitliche Verkabelung bildet das Fundament, auf dem alle aktiven Netzwerkkomponenten wie [Switches, Router](https://nls-netzwerke.de/service/switching-routertechnologie/ "Switches, Router") und Access Points aufbauen. Die internationale Norm ISO/IEC 11801 sowie die europäische EN 50173 definieren dabei genau, wie eine solche Verkabelung aufgebaut sein muss. ## Die drei Ebenen der strukturierten Verkabelung Ein strukturiertes Verkabelungssystem gliedert sich in drei hierarchische Bereiche: **Primärverkabelung (Campusverkabelung):** Diese Ebene verbindet verschiedene Gebäude auf einem Firmengelände miteinander. evidence.title: The next step in the growth strategy: SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa is renamed as SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria | SPIE
evidence.excerpt: [**Share price** **€46.56** +0.13%](/en/investors/share-price) * + [FR](https://www.spie.com/fr/journalistes/actualites/prochaine-etape-de-la-strategie-de-croissance-spie-deutschland-zentraleuropa-devient-spie-germany-switzerland-austria) ![](/sites/www.spie.com/files/styles/eco_480x338/public/2024-10/intra-banner-spie-gsa-.jpg?h=c9a3a702&itok=OiFfGdw2) * [Group](/en/group) [Press release](/en/press-release) # The next step in the growth strategy: SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa is renamed as SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria Published on 01 October 2024 **Ratingen, 1 October 2024** – *SPIE, the independent European leader in multi-technical services in the areas of energy and communications, is reorganising its operating structure and announcing the renaming of SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa as SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria.* The SPIE Group is adapting its operating structure to the company’s strong growth. Tier 1 units SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa and SPIE Switzerland will become SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria and SPIE Central Europe. SPIE Central Europe serves the markets in Poland, Slovakia, the Czech Republic and Hungary. SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria is driving business and growth in Germany, Switzerland and Austria. **Germany has the potential to become SPIE’s largest market** “*The importance of SPIE in Germany has grown steadily within the SPIE Group over the past eleven years measured in terms of its revenue and profit contribution and employee headcount. Going forward, we see plenty of potential for further growth in the German market and we are adapting our structures to facilitate it*,” explained Gauthier Louette, Chairman & CEO of the SPIE Group. SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa’s growth strategy was launched in 2013. “*In just eleven years, Markus Holzke and his management team have developed SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa very successfully and have grown the business significantly. After three platform acquisitions and 30 bolt-on acquisitions, SPIE has evolved into the leading multi-technical service provider in Germany, Austria, Poland, Slovakia, the Czech Republic and Hungary, and its workforce has expanded from 300 to almost 23,000 employees. That’s a fantastic achievement. I am fully confident that the management team will continue to follow this roadmap to success and develop Germany into SPIE’s biggest market*,” commented Gauthier Louette. **The company will be renamed on 1 October 2024** On 1 October 2024, SPIE Deutschland & Zentraleuropa GmbH will be renamed as SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria GmbH. This company will be the lead company for all subsidiaries operating in Germany, Switzerland and Austria, including entities with representative offices for customers in other countries according to the “follow the customer” principle. **SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria remains on a growth trajectory** “*Our new organisational structure reflects SPIE’s comprehensive technical expertise in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and beyond. Together, we are around 20,000 team members working with our customers to establish a climate-friendly and digital future. I am very much looking forward to growing and expanding our business with the support of the entire SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria management team, and to extending the range and depth of our services*,” added Markus Holzke, Managing Director/CEO of SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria. The SPIE Germany Switzerland Austria management structure consists of eight business units organised by market and country, as well as the headquarters: * **Operational Division Efficient Facilities (EF), managed by Rainer Hollang:**Around 4,300 employees provide technical facility management, energy efficiency solutions and renewable energies (own power generation, CO2-free heat generation and cooling systems) for our customers’ buildings and sites. * **Operational Division CityNetworks & Grids (CNG), managed by Peter Pfannenstiel:**Around 5,400 team members deploy

evidence.title: Wi-Fi 7 erklärt: Vorteile & Einsatz mit Glasfaser
evidence.excerpt: [News | DNSNET Internet Service GmbH](https://www.dns-net.de/news) # [Wi-Fi 7 erklärt: Vorteile, MLO & Glasfaser | DNS:NET](https://www.dns-net.de/news/wi-fi-7-vorteile-glasfaser) Geschrieben von [Iseewanga Buch](https://www.dns-net.de/news/author/iseewanga-buch) | Sep 24, 2025 12:33:02 PM ## Was ist Wi-Fi 7 und welche Vorteile bringt es? Wi-Fi 7 ist die neueste WLAN-Technologie, die für deutlich höhere Geschwindigkeiten, stabilere Verbindungen und geringere Latenzen im Heimnetz sorgt. Der größte Vorteil: Wi-Fi 7 kann mehrere Frequenzbänder gleichzeitig nutzen und verteilt die verfügbare Bandbreite effizient auf viele Geräte. Dadurch bleiben Verbindungen auch bei hoher Auslastung zuverlässig und schnell. In Kombination mit einem Glasfaseranschluss entfaltet Wi-Fi 7 sein volles Potenzial und verhindert, dass das WLAN zum Engpass wird – für reibungsloses Streaming, Gaming und Arbeiten im Homeoffice. ### Der neueste WLAN-Standard Wi-Fi 7 (IEEE 802.11be) ist der neue WLAN-Standard, der seit Juli 2025 finalisiert und schon heute in ersten Routern und Endgeräten verfügbar ist. Mit Multi-Link-Operation (MLO), 320-MHz-Kanälen und 4K-QAM bietet Wi-Fi 7 deutlich mehr Geschwindigkeit, Stabilität und geringere Latenzen als seine Vorgänger. Für Streaming, Gaming, Homeoffice und Smart-Home ist das ein echter Technologiesprung. In Kombination mit DNS:NET-Glasfaser entfaltet Wi-Fi 7 sein volles Potenzial. ### Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) im Detail Wi-Fi 7, auch bekannt als IEEE 802.11be, ist der neueste internationale WLAN-Standard. Am 22. Juli 2025 wurde er final verabschiedet und die [Wi-Fi Alliance](https://www.wi-fi.org/) bietet seit Anfang 2024 ein offizielles Zertifizierungsprogramm an. Gegenüber Wi-Fi 6 und 6E bringt Wi-Fi 7 wesentliche Verbesserungen: * [**Multi-Link Operation (MLO):**](https://www.dns-net.de/glossar/mlo) gleichzeitige Nutzung mehrerer Frequenzbänder (2,4/5/6 GHz) → mehr Stabilität, geringere Latenzen. * Breitere Kanäle bis [320 MHz](https://www.dns-net.de/news/320-mhz-kanal-wifi7): Verdopplung der Bandbreite ggü. Wi-Fi 6. * [4K-QAM-Modulation](https://www.dns-net.de/glossar/4k-qam)**:** rund 20 % mehr Spitzenleistung. * Verbesserte [MU-MIMO](https://www.dns-net.de/glossar/mu-mimo) und [OFDMA](https://www.dns-net.de/glossar/ofdma) für effizientere Netzwerknutzung. Kurz gesagt: Wi-Fi 7 ist das WLAN der nächsten Generation – entwickelt für datenintensive Anwendungen wie 4K/8K-Streaming, Cloud-Gaming oder Homeoffice. Mit DNS:NET-Glasfaser wird die volle Leistung nutzbar – ohne Flaschenhals im Netz. > [**Passende Glasfaser-Tarife mit Wi-Fi-7-Router ansehen**](https://www.dns-net.de/glasfaser/tarife) ### Die wichtigsten Neuerungen von Wi-Fi 7 Wi-Fi 7 bringt eine Reihe technischer Innovationen, die das Heimnetz deutlich leistungsfähiger machen. Hier die zentralen Features, klar erklärt: #### Multi-Link Operation (MLO) Herzstück von Wi-Fi 7: Router und Endgeräte können mehrere Frequenzbänder (2,4/5/6 GHz) gleichzeitig nutzen. * Ergebnis: geringere Latenzen, stabilere Verbindungen, weniger Ausfälle bei Störungen. * Besonders wichtig für Gaming, VR und Videokonferenzen. #### 320-MHz-Kanäle * Verdopplung der Kanalbreite im Vergleich zu Wi-Fi 6 (160 MHz → 320 MHz). * Mehr Bandbreite = höhere Spitzendurchsätze von über 40 Gbit/s im Labor. * In der Praxis: spürbare Performance-Steigerung bei datenintensiven Anwendungen wie 8K-Streaming. #### 4K-QAM-Modulation * Höhere Signalverdichtung: rund 20 % mehr Durchsatz als Wi-Fi 6 (1024-QAM). * Vorteil: effizientere Nutzung des Funkspektrums. * Hinweis: Erfordert stabile Signalqualität – daher besonders im Glasfaserumfeld sinnvoll. #### Verbesserte Effizienz-Features * Optimierungen bei MU-MIMO (mehr gleichzeitige Verbindungen) und OFDMA (effiziente Aufteilung der Kanäle). * **[Puncturing](https://www.dns-net.de/glossar/channel-puncturing)/Multi-RU**: bessere Nutzung von Kanälen auch bei Störungen. * Ergebnis: mehr Kapazität für Smarthomes mit vielen Geräten. ### Wi-Fi 7 in Deutschland Während in d

Doch wie viel von der Bandbreite zu Hause tatsächlich ankommt, entscheidet dein Router. Mit aktuellen WLAN-Standards wie Wi-Fi 6E und Wi-Fi 7, vielen vernetzten Geräten und höheren Sicherheitsanforderungen ist ein zukunftssicheres Modell unverzichtbar. Doch worauf solltest du wirklich achten? DNS:NET liefert dir Antworten, basierend auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen, geprüften Testergebnissen und aktuellen Techniktrends. *Du möchtest wissen, welcher Router zu Deinem Anschluss und zu Deiner Wohnsituation passt? Dann prüfe jetzt die passende Lösung für Deinen Glasfaseranschluss.* [Passenden Router finden](https://www.dns-net.de/router) In diesem FAQ erfährst du: * welcher Router zu einem Glasfaseranschluss von DNS:NET passt * wann sich Wi-Fi 7, Mesh-WLAN oder ein einfacher Router lohnt * welche Sicherheitsfunktionen 2026 Pflicht sind * welche Lösungen wir für Familien, Mieter:innen, Eigentümer:innen, Gamer:innen und Senior:innen empfehlen ``` ``` ### Was ist 2026 bei der Routerwahl besonders wichtig? 2026 müssen Router vorrangig eines sein: zukunftssicher und leistungsstark. Das heißt: * Unterstützung für Wi-Fi 6, 6E oder Wi-Fi 7. Inzwischen Standard für stabile, schnelle Verbindungen. * Multi-Gigabit-Anschlüsse (mindestens 1 Gbps, besser 2,5 Gbps oder SFP+) passend zu heutigen Glasfaseranschlüssen. * Leistungsfähiges Mesh-WLAN für lückenlose Abdeckung. * Moderne Sicherheitsfunktionen wie WPA3, automatische Updates und eine integrierte Firewall. * Eine einfache, intuitive Bedienung per App oder über die Weboberfläche für alle Haushaltsmitglieder. ### Brauche ich einen speziellen Router für Glasfaser? Ja. Ein moderner Glasfaseranschluss erfordert weiterhin einen Router mit WAN-Port (mindestens 1 Gbps, besser 2,5 Gbps) oder SFP+-Slot. Viele aktuelle Modelle ab 2025 und 2026 unterstützen Multi-Gigabit zuverlässig. DNS:NET stellt dir eine Kompatibilitätsliste bereit und berät dich persönlich, damit alles reibungslos funktioniert. ### Worauf sollte ich bei einem Wi‑Fi‑7‑Router achten? Ein [moderner Wi-Fi-7-Router](/router) entscheidet 2026 spürbar darüber, ob dein Glasfaseranschluss seine volle Leistung entfalten kann. Achte besonders auf: * **Multi-Link Operation (MLO)**: parallele Nutzung mehrerer Bänder für höhere Stabilität und geringere Latenz. * **Tri-Band-Unterstützung:** optimale Lastverteilung für Streaming, Gaming und Smart Home. * **2,5-G- und 10-G-Ports:** wichtig für Multi-Gigabit-Glasfaseranschlüsse. * **Mesh-Funktionalität:** für größere Wohnungen, Altbauten und Häuser in Berlin und Brandenburg. * **Security:** WPA3 als Standard, regelmäßige Updates und ein klarer Update-Pfad hin zu WPA4. * **Glasfaseroptimierung**: Router sollten Bandbreiten von 500 Mbit/s bis 10 Gbit/s vollständig durchleiten. ### Welcher WLAN-Standard ist sinnvoll: Wi-Fi 6, 6E oder 7? evidence.title: DNS:NET setzt neue Maßstäbe im Glasfasermarkt: 10-GBit-Technologie ab Oktober
evidence.excerpt: [News | DNSNET Internet Service GmbH](https://www.dns-net.de/news) # [DNS:NET bringt 10 Gbit/s-Technologie & Wi-Fi 7 nach Deutschland](https://www.dns-net.de/news/10-gbit-wifi7-xgs-pon-glasfaser-technologie-dnsnet) Geschrieben von [Claudia Burkhardt](https://www.dns-net.de/news/author/claudia-burkhardt) | Oct 16, 2025, 12:45:49 PM Auf der Basis von XGS-PON und der neuen Wi-Fi 7 Tri-Band-Lösung gibt es Glasfaserprodukte der Spitzenklasse **[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)** Berlin, 16. Oktober 2025 – Nachdem auf dem [NetworkX-Event](https://networkxevent.com/) in Paris von der DNS:NET der Einsatz der [neuen Wi-Fi-7-Tri-Band-Lösung](https://www.dns-net.de/news/zte-dnsnet-wifi7-xgspon-tri-band-loesung-deutschland) demonstriert wurde, stellt die DNS:NET ihr neues Produktportfolio für die Breitbandversorgung in Deutschland vor. Ab sofort erhalten Neukunden und Bestandskunden standardmäßig im neuen Portfolio den neuen Wi-Fi-7-Tri-Band-Router. #### ****DNS:NET führt mit der neuen 10-GBit/s-Technologie einen High-End-Standard für Privatkunden ein**** Jeder Privatkunde kann ab sofort neben dem beliebten 1-GBit/s-Tarif „DERTarif“ auch einen neuen Glasfaser-Tarif mit modernster 10-GBit/s-Technologie buchen. In Kombination mit dem neuen Wi-Fi-7-Tri-Band-Router bietet DNS:NET damit eine Highspeed-Lösung der nächsten Generation. Mit DNS:NET-Glasfaser kommt so die besonders stabile 10-GBit/s-Technologie direkt bis ins Zuhause. DNS:NET-Kunden erhalten damit auch die neuesten Router auf Basis von Wi-Fi 7. Der neue DNS:NET Premium-Router mit Wi-Fi 7 Tri-Band ist ab sofort bei allen Glasfasertarifen inklusive – vorkonfiguriert und sofort einsatzbereit. DNS:NET ist somit einer der ersten Anbieter in Deutschland, die Wi-Fi-7-Router mit Tri-Band für Glasfaseranschlüsse mit 10-GBit/s-Technologie einsetzen. > „Mit 10 GBit/s Glasfaser – dem sogenannten XGS-PON und Wi-Fi 7 bringen wir die Zukunft direkt ins Wohnzimmer. Unsere Mission bleibt: Menschen mit Lichtgeschwindigkeit begeistern – regional, unabhängig und auf dem modernsten Stand der Technik.“, so Kim Juchem, CCO der DNS:NET. ****Die Fakten im Überblick:**** * **10 GBit/s-Technologie** (Line-Rate, XGS-PON) bzw. typisch 8–8,5 GBit/s netto symmetrisch an DNS:NET-Glasfaseradressen * **Router inklusive**in allen Tarifen – keine Zusatzkosten, keine Konfigurationshürden * **High-End-Internet** wird massenmarktfähig; jeder kann sich 10-GBit/s-Technologie leisten (19,99 € für die ersten 12 Monate). Der neue symmetrische Privatkundentarif kostet 99 € im Monat und beinhaltet den Wi-Fi-7-Router bereits. In den ersten zwölf Monaten bietet DNSNET den Tarif für nur 19,99 € an, sodass alle Kunden das High-Speed-Wunder testen können. * Ausbau- und Versorgungsgebiete erhalten automatisch das **volle Potenzial auf Basis von XGS-PON**.**[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)****[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)****[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)****[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)** **[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)** #### ****Technik auf einen Blick**** **[](https://www.dns-net.de/news/glasfaserausbau-falkensee)** ****Wi-Fi 7** bringt eine Reihe technischer Innovationen für mehr Leistungsfähigkeit:** * **Multi-Link Operation (MLO):** Die Router und Endgeräte können mehrere Frequenzbänder (2,4/5/6 GHz) gleichzeitig nutzen. Somit gibt es geringere Latenzen, stabilere Verbindungen und damit weniger Ausfälle bei Störungen. * **320-MHz-Kanäle** führen zur Verdopplung der Kanalbreite im Vergleich zu Wi-Fi 6 (160 MHz→MHz → 320 MHz). Im Ergebnis gibt es bis zu 40 Gbit/s theoretische Spitzendurchsätze im Labor – deutlich mehr Bandbreite und stabilere Verbindungen. Dadurch gibt es eine spürbare Performance-Steigerung bei datenintensiven Anwendungen (u.a. 8K-Streaming, VR, Videokonferenz etc.). * **4K-QAM-Modulation:** Das bedeutet – es gibt eine höhere Signalverdichtung. Rund zwan

[Proceed to site](# "3i Infrastructure") [Terms and conditions](/about-us/ "About us") 3i-infrastructure Logo * [Home](/) * [Newsroom](/newsroom/) * [Press releases](/newsroom/press-releases/) * [3i Infrastructure plc agrees to acquire DNS:NET](/newsroom/press-releases/2021/3i-infrastructure-plc-agrees-to-acquire-dnsnet/) # Newsroom # 3i Infrastructure plc agrees to acquire DNS:NET ![Dns Net Wulkau 2016 1241](/media/2oukap3k/dns_net_wulkau_2016_1241.jpg?width=856&height=535&v=1db4bdc1dd5c9c0) **3i Infrastructure plc (“3i Infrastructure”) has agreed to invest c.€182m to acquire a 60% stake in DNS:NET and to provide additional funding for the future growth of the business. DNS:NET is a leading independent telecommunications provider in Germany.** 3i Infrastructure is buying its stake from Deutsche Beteiligungs AG (“DBAG”), DBAG ECF, a private equity fund managed by DBAG, and Founder and CEO Alexander Lucke, with the latter reinvesting alongside 3i Infrastructure to retain a 40% stake. Completion is expected to take place in June 2021. Established in 1998, DNS:NET owns the largest independent fibre-to-the-cabinet network in the Berlin area, as well as three data centres. The company differentiates itself through a superior network, local brand recognition and attractive pricing of high bandwidth products, which drives high customer satisfaction. In recent years, DNS:NET has commenced a fibre-to-the-home (“FTTH”) rollout which it now plans to accelerate with 3i Infrastructure’s backing. Fibre is superior to other broadband access technologies because it provides reliable low latency, high bandwidth and distance-independent connectivity for both download and upload. Demand for FTTH connectivity is forecast to grow rapidly, as consumers normalise data intensive activities such as cloud-based remote working, high definition streaming and online gaming, and increasingly view high speed broadband as an essential service. Germany lags behind most European countries in its FTTH deployment, with only 14% coverage today compared to the European average of 33%. The market is projected to grow at 30% p.a. to meet the German government’s objective of every one of its 43 million households having access to gigabit speed broadband by 2025. Richard Laing, Chair of 3i Infrastructure, commented: “DNS:NET is an asset-intensive business delivering an essential service in a sector with strong underlying demand trends. It is a high growth asset which will further diversify our portfolio, giving 3i Infrastructure sizeable exposure to the German infrastructure market for the first time.” Phil White, Managing Partner and Head of Infrastructure, 3i Investments plc, Investment Manager of 3i Infrastructure, added: “For businesses and consumers alike, fibre connectivity is increasingly a necessity as data and computing power moves to the cloud. Alexander has built a highly successful business over more than 20 years and we look forward to partnering with him and his management team as DNS:NET rolls out its fibre-to-the-home offering in Berlin and the surrounding area.” Peter Wirtz, co-Managing Director 3i Germany, commented: “Alexander is an impressive entrepreneur, who has built a highly regarded business, and we are delighted to be backing him and his management team. We are also pleased to be expanding into the German infrastructure market which we think offers attractive opportunities.”

evidence.title: ATTB and ENO telecom agree on distribution partnership
evidence.excerpt: ![Home](/fileadmin/template/desaysv/desay_logo.jpg "Home") ![News and information of Antennentechnik Bad Blankenburg (ATTB)](/fileadmin/_processed_/6/9/csm_kopfbild_news_0c6018c253.jpg "News and information of Antennentechnik Bad Blankenburg (ATTB)") # ATTB and ENO telecom agree on distribution partnership 07/27/2021 News The products of Antennentechnik Bad Blankenburg will now also be distributed by ENO telecom GmbH. The company, founded in 1993, is based in Nordhorn, Lower Saxony, and is one of the leading distributors in the ICT sector. As part of the partnership, ENO telecom will distribute a range of original ATTB products, including antennas, amplifiers, splitters, cables and the WiCAR® LTE router. Target groups are primarily B2B customers such as vehicle manufacturers, telematics solution providers and installers. Services include consulting, purchase processing and shipping. ### Leading ICT distributor The products of Antennentechnik Bad Blankenburg will now also be distributed by ENO telecom GmbH. The company, founded in 1993, is based in Nordhorn, Lower Saxony, and is one of the leading distributors in the ICT sector. As part of the partnership, ENO telecom will distribute a range of original ATTB products, including antennas, amplifiers, splitters, cables and the WiCAR® LTE router. Target groups are primarily B2B customers such as vehicle manufacturers, telematics solution providers and installers. Services include consulting, purchase processing and shipping. ### Authorized partner for DACH region "We are very pleased to welcome ENO telecom as a new authorized sales partner to our ranks," says Jan Krönke, International Channel Manager at Antennentechnik Bad Blankenburg. "With this new partnership, we are further expanding our distribution activities in the automotive aftermarket and telecommunications sectors in the DACH region." Joint marketing and sales activities have also been agreed. ### Expanded ENO portfolio "With ATTB, we have gained a reliable partner that meaningsfully expands our portfolio and scores with over 100 years of experience "Made in Germany". Due to the excellent technical development work, we see very good approaches for our joint business here, because ATTB offers us not only product, but also customer-specific adaptations," says Heinrich Thelker, Product Manager Mobile Accessories, Wearables & Fun at ENO telecom. ### About ENO telecom ENO telecom is one of the leading distributors in the ICT sector and sells products and services in the areas of smartphones & tablets, network marketing, fixed line & network, automotive, smart home, computers & peripherals, home entertainment, white goods, gaming, UCC and accessories. The services support retailers and are also aimed at cross-company partners who require complete project management. All services can be combined from the Customer Solution Center and logistics fulfillments to stationary and mobile service via the company's own repair center ECC ESC. In fiscal 2020, ENO generated sales of over 250 million euros with 185 employees. More information at [www.eno.de](http://www.eno.de). ![image-3019](/fileadmin/_processed_/2/a/csm_ENO_pressebild_web_020c3ad2e7.jpg) © 2026 Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH Follow us
